The only handshakes are between witches and sorcerers. No witch shakes hands with another witch, and no sorcerer shakes hands with another sorcerer.

Each of the 6 witches shakes hands with each of the 10 sorcerers. That gives 6 × 10 = 60 handshakes.

The solution counts no handshake twice, because each one involves exactly one witch and one sorcerer. Counting from the sorcerers' side gives the same total, 10 × 6 = 60. The final answer of 60 is correct.
